capabilities: Chat with notes through an OpenAI-compatible model
Attach notes and Markdown skills to a conversation
Surface notes related to the note being read
Search notes by keyword and semantic similarity
Build and maintain a local SQLite index of the vault
disambiguation: Not a fiction plotting or outlining tool; the name refers to the thread between notes.
extras: Free and needs no Trama account. The SQLite index lives in the app's browser storage (OPFS) outside the vault, so it is device-local and not covered by vault backups or sync. Only a fixed placeholder bearer token is sent, so direct API-key connections are unsupported and paid APIs need a gateway. Chat history is session-only and not saved to disk.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to ask questions about your notes, find notes related by meaning, or search for an idea when you have forgotten the exact wording.

relations.evidence: Local servers such as LM Studio can provide chat and embeddings without a paid API.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible model server with chat and embedding endpoints

summary: Local-first AI plugin that adds a chat view, related-note discovery, and keyword-plus-semantic search over an indexed vault.
